faqs.subTitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.title: Everything You Need to Know About Our CRM Solution

items.question: What is POS software?
items.answer: POS (Point of Sale) software is a system that allows businesses to process sales transactions, manage inventory, track customer data and generate reports. It is used at the point where a customer makes a purchase.

items.question: Does the software support multiple locations?
items.answer: Yes, you can manage multiple store locations from a single POS dashboard with centralized control over inventory, staff and sales data.

items.question: Is it possible to track real-time sales and inventory?
items.answer: Yes, with our cloud-based POS, you can monitor sales, stock levels and employee activity in real-time from any device.
